notes: Patient key. Identifier only - never a model feature. Grouping key for all splits.
Index admission key. Identifier only - never a model feature.
Patient-level split assignment. Admission-level splitting is prohibited.
Derived: anchor_age + (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admittime) - anchor_year). Use the derived age only; the anchor year itself must never enter the model. MIMIC caps age at 91 for patients over 89.
M/F as recorded. Static; no timestamp to violate.
EXCLUDED by protocol: encodes absolute calendar era. Dates are patient-shifted, so this is a population-level temporal artefact.
Count of the patient's admissions with dischtime < index admittime. Window functions must be bounded to rows preceding the index admission.
Prior admissions carrying a qualifying HF code. Uses only admissions discharged before the index admittime.
Index admittime minus the previous dischtime. NULL for first-ever admission - missingness is informative, do not impute with 0.
Prior admissions starting in the 30 days before index admittime.
Prior admissions starting in the 90 days before index admittime.
Prior admissions starting in the 365 days before index admittime.
Prior admissions with an emergency admission_type. Category vocabulary must be pinned at Day 2.
Total inpatient days across all prior completed admissions.
Index length of stay. Fully determined at the cutoff.
Known at admission.
Known at admission.
EXCLUDED as a predictor: recorded at the cutoff but strongly outcome-encoding (e.g. hospice, against advice). Retain as a stratification/QC field only.
EXCLUDED: absolute calendar time is meaningless under per-patient date shifting.
9 or 10. Coding-era proxy; keep for QC and sensitivity analysis rather than as a clinical feature.
Position of the HF code in the index billing list. seq_num=1 approximates principal diagnosis.
Diagnosis-code count on the index admission; a crude complexity proxy.
ICD-10 N18* or ICD-9 585*. Index + prior admissions only.
ICD-10 J44* or ICD-9 496*.
Candidate composite. Requires a pinned ICD-to-Charlson crosswalk at Day 2; both ICD versions must map.
Same comorbidity flags restricted to admissions discharged before the index admission - the leakage-free variant if discharge-coded index diagnoses prove too permissive.
Last creatinine value with charttime <= cutoff. Renal function; the primary renal signal. Filter to blood specimens and valuenum IS NOT NULL; pin itemids at Day 2 from the audit report.
Maximum creatinine during the index admission up to the cutoff.
Last minus first creatinine within the index admission - the within-stay trajectory term.
Number of creatinine results before the cutoff; measurement frequency itself carries acuity signal.

Last BUN / urea nitrogen value with charttime <= cutoff. Renal and volume status; BUN/creatinine ratio is a candidate derived feature. Filter to blood specimens and valuenum IS NOT NULL; pin itemids at Day 2 from the audit report.
Maximum BUN / urea nitrogen during the index admission up to the cutoff.
Last minus first BUN / urea nitrogen within the index admission - the within-stay trajectory term.
Number of BUN / urea nitrogen results before the cutoff; measurement frequency itself carries acuity signal.
Last sodium value with charttime <= cutoff. Hyponatremia is an established HF prognostic marker. Filter to blood specimens and valuenum IS NOT NULL; pin itemids at Day 2 from the audit report.
Maximum sodium during the index admission up to the cutoff.
Last minus first sodium within the index admission - the within-stay trajectory term.
Number of sodium results before the cutoff; measurement frequency itself carries acuity signal.
Last potassium value with charttime <= cutoff. Tracks diuretic and RAAS-inhibitor effects. Filter to blood specimens and valuenum IS NOT NULL; pin itemids at Day 2 from the audit report.
Maximum potassium during the index admission up to the cutoff.
Last minus first potassium within the index admission - the within-stay trajectory term.
Number of potassium results before the cutoff; measurement frequency itself carries acuity signal.
Last hemoglobin value with charttime <= cutoff. Anemia is a common HF comorbidity. Filter to blood specimens and valuenum IS NOT NULL; pin itemids at Day 2 from the audit report.
Maximum hemoglobin during the index admission up to the cutoff.
Last minus first hemoglobin within the index admission - the within-stay trajectory term.
Number of hemoglobin results before the cutoff; measurement frequency itself carries acuity signal.
Median creatinine from admissions discharged before the index admission - the longitudinal baseline for renal trajectory.
creatinine_last minus creatinine_baseline_prior. NULL when no prior admission exists.
Derived from creatinine_last, age and sex (CKD-EPI). Derived only; race coefficients are not used.
CONDITIONAL on availability - see the audit report before use. BNP and NT-proBNP are different assays with different scales and must not be pooled into one column.
Explicit availability indicator so that assay absence is modelled rather than silently imputed.
Count of results flagged abnormal before the cutoff. Vocabulary of flag must be pinned at Day 2.

CANDIDATE ONLY. Name matching on lisinopril/enalapril/losartan/valsartan/sacubitril.
CANDIDATE ONLY. Name matching on carvedilol/metoprolol/bisoprolol.
CANDIDATE ONLY. Name matching on spironolactone/eplerenone.
CANDIDATE ONLY. Name matching on dapagliflozin/empagliflozin.
CANDIDATE ONLY. Polypharmacy proxy over the index admission up to the cutoff.
DEFERRED past Day 1. dose_val_rx is free text with ranges, and units vary by drug; normalisation must be specified before any dose feature is built.
Availability metadata only. Notes with NULL charttime cannot be proven pre-cutoff and must be dropped, not assumed.
Availability flag for a possible future text layer. No note text is used at Day 1.
Cohort exclusion criterion, never a predictor. Index admissions with flag=1 are removed.
Cohort exclusion criterion, never a predictor. Cross-checked against hospital_expire_flag in the audit.
Post-discharge death. Competing risk for the readmission outcome; used for censoring analysis only, never as a feature.
Derived competing-risk indicator reported alongside the outcome. Not a predictor.
hadm_id of the next admission from LEAD(admittime) partitioned by subject_id ordered by admittime, hadm_id.
next_admittime minus index dischtime. NULL when no later admission is recorded. Post-cutoff by construction.
SECONDARY OUTCOME. 1 when days_to_next_admission > 0 and <= 30; else 0.
PRIMARY OUTCOME. 1 when days_to_next_admission > 0 and <= 90; else 0. Next admission may be any cause.
